description: Nonlinear element for the response shaper
notes: Breath is unipolar so only one ever conducts in play; the second covers the power-on and fault excursions. Scaling is set at /2 so the knee lands at about a quarter of a hard blow - at /10 it would sit ABOVE the playing range and the control would do nothing until you overblow. *** THE 0.6 V KNEE THIS SHAPER DEPENDS ON IS NOT-IN-DOCUMENT AS A SPEC. *** Neither banked datasheet specifies V_F at 0.6V; it is readable only off Vishay's TYPICAL Fig.1 (~1mA at 25degC), and that curve shifts more than 100mV LEFT at 150degC - on a part whose entire behaviour is where the knee sits. The tightest SPECIFIED bound in the bank is Diotec's V_F < 0.855V at 10mA, still 250mV above the asserted knee. *** NAME THE MANUFACTURER WHEN ORDERING: *** Vishay's 1N4148W (Document 86356 Rev 1.0) is a true SOD-123 - 2.7 x 1.55mm body, 3.7mm overall, 1.175mm high, R-thJA 440 K/W, P_tot 280mW on the recommended footprint, I_F(AV) 250mA, V_F <=1V at 10mA, C_D 1.5pF max, t_rr 4ns - while Diotec's same-numbered part is SOD-123F, flat lead, no standoff. Use Vishay's 440 K/W / 280mW as the conservative thermal pair; Diotec's 312 K/W / 400mW assume 3mm2 of copper per terminal. The plain 1N4148 is NEITHER package: it is leaded glass SOD27 (DO-35) axial. Which of the two SMD sizes to use is open and is decided by the board - either is electrically identical here

Same part as POT-GAIN; RV09 order-code traps are on that row and are not repeated here. *** THE CENTRE DETENT IS HONESTLY WARRANTED HERE AND NOT ELSEWHERE: *** at centre the wiper sits at exactly 0V by topology - it spans +Vin/2 and -Vin/2 - so the nonlinear branch carries no current and the stage is mathematically linear. POT-OFFSET's detent would land ~20 degrees off its true zero instead, which is why it gets one only if E10 decides feel beats accuracy there
